caption:
Study from your own notes with NotebookLM.

It is a free Google tool. You add PDFs, notes or links, ask questions, and the answers point back to your sources.

Try it on one chapter: ask for a summary, likely exam questions, and a simple explanation of the hardest part. It only knows what you upload, so check key facts against your textbook.

Have you tried it? Tell us below.
